work.title: Kotlin Multiplatform Developer
work.description: Development of desktop applications for Windows and Linux using Kotlin Multiplatform and the JVM, working across different layers of the product and taking on responsibilities in both implementation and technical design.
highlights: UI/UX development, business logic, and reusable components with Compose Multiplatform
Implementation of Unix sockets for communication between different instances of the app
Participation in architecture decisions, code reviews, and PRs
Cross-functional participation, collaborating with design, QA, backend, and product

work.title: Cybersecurity Solutions Developer and Implementer
work.description: Responsible for interpreting and implementing the National Security Framework (ENS) within M2M Aplicaciones, ensuring the regulatory compliance needed for the company to continue providing services to businesses and public administrations.
highlights: Analysis and interpretation of ENS requirements for their implementation within the company
Deployment and configuration of firewalls and network segmentation to strengthen perimeter security
Design and implementation of backup and business continuity policies
Hardening and administration of Linux/Windows systems and servers
